text:
elaine: Quick question — we have an overnight deploy planned for 02:00 UTC to apply the embeddings cache fix. This falls inside the 48h freeze window for the launch. Is this an emergency exception or do we delay to after the launch window?

sam_rm: Not an emergency; the fix reduces inference cost but isn’t user-visible. We should probably hold unless we can do a canary that won’t affect traffic.

julian: Can we do a read-only canary on a dedicated pool? I can pin the model to v2.1-quant for canary only. No routing changes.

matt_sre: If it’s truly no routing, it’s probably ok as an approved exemption. Need an explicit owner, rollback plan, and that smoke tests are green. Also datadog alerting on 5xx and token-per-sec spike.

priya_pm: Agree with matt. Priya here — I can be owner during the window and coordinate support. Rollback plan: revert canary pin to v2.0 and drain canary pool. If any error rate > 0.5% for 5m we rollback.

elaine: Thanks. julian, can you post the exact commands and smoke tests you’ll run so deploy-bot can tag them?

julian: Sure — canary plan below.

```
# pin model on pool canary-embed-1
redwoodctl pin --pool canary-embed-1 --model redwood/embed-v2.1-quant --reason "prelaunch cost fix canary"
# run smoke tests (8 checks)
./scripts/smoke_embeddings.sh --pool canary-embed-1
```

julian: Smoke script covers token throughput, spot latency p95, kv-cache hit rate, and a small eval set (local). Output uploads to /artifacts/canary-embed-1976543210.log

deploy-bot: AUTO: canary started for release 2026.03.15 canary-embed-1 on pool canary-embed-1. canary_id=cb-1976543210-1

matt_sre: Copy. I’ve added temporary monitors: datadog monitor ID dd-embed-canary-1976543210, alerting to #oncall with 2m paging threshold.

oncall-bot: ALERT CONFIGURED: dd-embed-canary-1976543210 -> pages oncall-schedule (2m), notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

julian: Running smoke tests now. Posting summary in 10m.

- 10m later -

julian: smoke results: 8/8 pass. p95 latency +3% baseline, kv-cache hit +7%. No 5xx. Upload: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/canary/1976543210/log.txt

priya_pm: Looks good. Sam, want to sign off the freeze exemption?

sam_rm: Signoff: exception approved for canary-only pin. Condition: no traffic divergence, no user-visible errors, auto-rollback on alert. :thumbsup:

elaine: Noted. I’ll mark this on the launch board and update release notes: "Canary-only embeddings cache optimization applied during freeze; no user impact expected."

matt_sre: After 2h of clean canary metrics we can either extend to a small traffic slice (10%) or revert and schedule full rollout post-launch. Recommendation: revert to avoid changing anything for launch unless we need the cost fix urgently.

priya_pm: Agreed. Revert at +2h unless flagged. julian, schedule the revert command to run at 04:05 UTC unless we manually extend.

julian: Revert job scheduled:
```
redwoodctl unpin --pool canary-embed-1 --canary cb-1976543210-1 --reason "end canary - freeze window policy"
```

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: unpin job queued at 1976543505 for cb-1976543210-1.

elaine: Thanks everyone. I’ll post a short note in #launch-readiness after the revert confirming status.

matt_sre: Small operational note: if alert flapping happens, do not escalate to oncall unless sustained >5m. We'll keep the page policy stricter for the window.

priya_pm: Copy that. I’ll monitor for the next 3 hours.

elaine: Closing thread for the exemption. If anything changes ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
